providers.title: Fourier expansion on the cube
providers.scope: Characters are orthonormal; every function on the cube equals its Fourier expansion, with Parseval's identity; degree is subadditive under products.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Linear bound (Nisan-Szegedy)
providers.scope: For Boolean f, the sum of the |f^({i})| is at most the total influence, which is at most deg f.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Calculus of observations
providers.scope: Functions of observations with cell degree bounds have bounded degree; scores add over disjoint blocks; sign(T_F) has linear correlation E|T_F|.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Fourth moments of averages
providers.scope: E Z_M^4 = E T^4/(M v^2) + 3(M-1)/M for normalized sums of bounded centred variables.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Restricted moments
providers.scope: If Z_n is asymptotically standard normal with mean 0 and variance 1, then E[1_J(Z_n) Z_n^a] tends to its Gaussian value for finite unions of intervals J and a <= 2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Product portmanteau
providers.scope: For independent copies and a Borel set with Gaussian-null boundary, probabilities and restricted sums converge to their Gaussian values.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Perturbations of asymptotic normality
providers.scope: Perturbations small in L^2 and scalings tending to one preserve asymptotic standard normality.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Amplification criterion
providers.scope: A rule on r inputs with coordinate cost d retaining variance at least d + eta for asymptotically normal inputs gives arbitrarily large ratios v(F)/D.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Cost of the refined report
providers.scope: The indicator of the tagged event is a combination of functions of m inputs, so the refined report has coordinate cost m.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Retained variance of the refined report
providers.scope: Var(E[L | W]) >= m + E[1_A (1 - (L - b)^2)] for every real b.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Gaussian design
providers.scope: Intervals and a selector for which the Gaussian deficit d_A exceeds (3/4) p_*.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Unbounded violations of the square-root degree bound (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For every C > 0 there is a nonconstant Boolean f with sum of f^({i}) > C sqrt(deg f).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Coarse report
providers.scope: The report with single marks on both exceptional events also satisfies the amplification criterion.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Refinement
providers.scope: An event of cost q-1 on which the sum has conditional variance below one extends to a costed partition with V > c = q - p_A.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Amplification from a mean cost advantage
providers.scope: A costed partition with Gaussian-null cell boundaries and V > c gives arbitrarily large ratios v(F)/D.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Weighted mixture
providers.scope: For large R the weighted-mixture event has positive probability and conditional variance of the sum below one.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Coarse report with small width
providers.scope: The coarse report retains m + Q H_w(U); H_w(G) tends to 1, and the small-width schedule satisfies the amplification criterion.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
